method: Frozen packets only (gold-set calibration-packet.json, unseen-test unseen-packet.json); no web research, no re-captured evidence. For every in-category record the species above the §3.1.1 tail marker (ordinal read where the marker is vacuous or none_visible) that bear on §9 — directional species, persistent films, glycols, and every species v1.0 counted as an L1/L3/L4 leg — are classified per §9-O1/O2 and verified rank-by-rank against the frozen INCI. Unlisted species above the tail are class `other` and cannot move the value. The rule is then applied mechanically (src/lib/leave-in-research/care-direction-t20.ts); tests/leave-in-care-direction-t20.test.ts re-runs it on every record.
unchanged_fields: Only care_direction reopens (§16: a standard-version bump reopens only the fields whose rules changed). Every other dimension, profile field, trace and approval of each base record stands unchanged and is not repeated here.

care_direction.note: T20 re-derivation (2026-09-29), value CHANGED moisture → balanced. The only directional species above the r14 Sodium Benzoate marker is the medium/rich-band lipid PRUNUS ARMENIACA KERNEL OIL r4 (§9-O1 DL). It is outranked by the persistent film DIMETHICONE r3 and flanked by PHENYL TRIMETHICONE r5 and DIMETHICONOL r8, so the film leads every directional species (§9-O3) and the oil leg is subordinate to it. TRISILOXANE r2 is a volatile carrier (M6) and contributes nothing; POLYQUATERNIUM-16 r9 and CETRIMONIUM CHLORIDE r11 are the cationic conditioning baseline (§9-O2) that COND already scores; HYDROLYZED KERATIN r6 is a plain hydrolysate, so there is no R2 route and no protein anchor (§7.10). GLYCERIN r15 sits below the marker and is subordinate. Confidence `low` under §9-O6: the film-lead margin is one rank (r3 vs r4), below the two-rank bar, so the read is adjacent-rank-fragile and routes to review. Nothing else on this silicone heat primer argues for moisture.
